bundle.copyright: Indian Barcode of Life kit (DBT; ATREE, UAS Bangalore, BSI). Rebuild 2026.
bundle.shortDescription: Identify Phyllanthus and rattans, with updated names and GenBank DNA data
bundle.longDescription: Version 2 (2026) of the Indian Barcode of Life identification kit: names updated to the Catalogue of Life with 2010 names kept, guided key, India distribution map, species comparison, glossary and GenBank DNA barcode data.
